notes: JPN is the sole semantic and structural authority; MLG_CN/ENG are auxiliary evidence only.
Coverage is contiguous for logical unique_index 0-356; multiline CSV rows were handled by logical unique_index, not physical line number.
Single-space placeholders, newline layouts, fullwidth indentation and the fullwidth space in ENTRY　GATE are preserved where present in JPN.
Dollar placeholders preserve JPN order and spacing, including $1 %, $1 $2$3, LV.$1(+$2), and LV.$1.
Fixed JPN ASCII labels/codes such as BLAVO, ALFA, GO! GO! GO!!!!, MISSION RESULT, NEXT, RANK, NEW and LV.UP are preserved rather than normalized from auxiliary text.
VERSUS uniform/camouflage identities follow JPN, including SQUARE singular, AUSCAM DESERT order, and the JPN uniform classification for SNAKE (naked).
Hero-spirit unlock lines preserve JPN punctuation intensity and ellipsis counts; nonlexical shouts such as キェーーー and はいだらー！ remain identity-preserved and review-flagged.
JPN 索敵 and 自律 terminology is preserved in AI-part/memory-board result rows rather than replaced by broader auxiliary terminology.
